page: Microsoft Azure DC64ads_v6 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the DCadsv6 server family. It is powered by an AMD processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 64 dedicated virtual CPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server configuration includes 2458 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, allowing for integration with high-speed persistent disk options. It does not include any integrated graphics processing units and comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and substantial local storage capacity, this instance offers a balanced resource density suitable for general-purpose workloads, database hosting, and applications requiring fast local scratch space. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities for multi-threaded enterprise workloads without resource contention.
